data.title: 新条茜 · 怪兽模型礼堂的粉色花嫁
data.description: 【模型工作室改造礼堂·黄昏】茜穿着粉紫婚纱坐在模型展示台边，捧花由她亲手做成小怪兽与花朵的组合；她把一只迷你怪兽摆正，朝镜头露出完美笑容，眼底却藏着只在私人时刻出现的柔软。
data.location: Akane’s model workshop arranged as a ceremony room
data.action: 模型展示台边整理藏在花束里的小怪兽，完美微笑转成柔软注视
data.lighting: pink-gold studio light through a high window
data.mood: 创世少女把世界做成花嫁模型
data.promptProse: Akane Shinjou from SSSS.GRIDMAN wears a lavender bridal dress with pink ribbons, a short veil and a bouquet mixing roses with tiny monster figurines. She sits beside her model display, carefully straightening a tiny monster hidden among the roses. Her polished smile faces the viewer first, then softens when she notices the small creation is standing perfectly beneath the lavender veil and warm studio light. pink-gold studio light through a high window.
